title: Cast Iron vs. PVC in Drainage Applications
description: Choosing between cast iron and plastic piping such as PVC or ABS impacts drainage performance, noise control, and longevity. Cast iron DWV pipe is heavy and dense, providing superior sound attenuation, making it ideal for multi-story residential stacks where water falling through pipes creates unwanted acoustic noise. It also offers excellent fire-resistance ratings. Conversely, PVC and ABS are lightweight, highly resistant to chemical corrosion, and faster to install. Understanding material characteristics helps plumbers select the right piping material based on acoustic requirements, structural loads, and building code specifications.
